lines.text: How can a snail rescue a star?
We haven't managed. I'm open to suggestions.
Is that the one from the tree?
The one I stepped over.
Get down here. Look along the water.
There was a road here the whole time?
We were looking over it.
It's disappearing where the sunlight touches it.
Then we need to move.
The reeds block this end. Where does it start?
There! Beside that flat stone.
Your hill finally has a job.
Excellent views. Terrible launching facilities.
The tower works better lying down.
Hold it steady. Our guide's coming across.
No rush, little one. Except... quite a lot of rush.
There's your way home. Right where we weren't looking.
Go on. We'll watch you get there.
It made it.
All that work. We never asked our guide's name.
Same time tomorrow?
Let's just lose a sock next time.
